beats.line: OpenAI just made prompt caching last twelve hours.
Cached tokens are cheaper and faster. Before, the cache went cold fast, so a lunch break meant paying full price again.
Now the API can hold it for twelve hours, and Codex says it keeps your cache when you come back to an old conversation.
Big win if you use long system prompts, agents, or work in a big repo all day.
Put the stable stuff at the top of your prompt so it gets cached. Full test on my channel.
